build_ssl_model: build a self-supervised learning model with trunk and head components using BaseSSLMultiInputOutputModel
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on a single input batch through the model trunk and heads
run_multi_input_forward: run a forward pass on multiple input types with separate head mappings for each input
run_multi_resolution_forward: run a forward pass on multiple resolution inputs and concatenate output features
freeze_model_trunk: freeze the model trunk parameters by setting requires_grad to False for all trunk parameters
